prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Find Your Perfect Pet Match", "Answer 3 quick questions to discover which desktop pet matches your working style.", "Select your work vibe"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "We are generating your pet's graphics and setting up desktop animations.", "Rendering Engine Active", "Estimated finish in ~3 mins"]
2: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet anytime, or right-click the system tray icon to access controls.", "Got It!", "Summon/Hide: Alt+P\nTalk to pet: Click pet directly\nSettings: Right-click tray icon"]
3: ["Sign In & Restore Your Pet Collection", "Signing in ensures your pets, custom photo creations, and settings are backed up safely.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled\nSaved Custom Styles Preserved\nMulti-Device Restore Ready"]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt", "Pick a ready-made companion in seconds, or upload photos to create a custom pet.", "Instant Pet (Ready immediately) vs Custom Pet (From your photo)"]
5: ["Can't see your pet on screen? Check your taskbar overflow menu or press Alt+P to center your pet."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new desktop pet is registered and ready to meet you!", "Pet Certificate Preview"]
7: ["Setting Up Desktop Overlay", "We are verifying screen compatibility so your pet walks smoothly on your desktop.", "Display driver check OK\nOverlay transparency set OK\nPet AI initialized OK"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Teammate", "Swipe to explore how your pet roams your desktop, reacts to clicks, and keeps you company.", "Desktop Pet Feature Preview"]
9: ["Upload Photo for Custom Pet", "Upload a clear photo. We'll automatically detect facial features and generate a 2D desktop pet model.", "Choose clear photo", "Pet Model Preview"]
